text.p: These are the main stories in Latvian newspapers on Friday, prepared for Reuters by the Co-operation Fund. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Board of The Democratic Party Saimnieks has voted to remove Aivars Kreituss from post of Minister of Finance. Decision to be approved today by the party's council.
- The Democratic Party Saimnieks and Latvia's Unity Party have signed agreement on forming political bloc. Newly-formed bloc will control 27 seats in parliament.

- Prime Minister Andris Shkele will ask parliament to ratify Latvia's oil exploration agreement with AMOCO/OPAB either next Thursday or at an extraordinary session. Agreement covers a disputed zone also claimed by Lithuania.
- Health Care Minister Juris Vinkelis said compulsory medical insurance will be introduced in Latvia next year, but gradually.

- Latvian President Guntis Ulmanis met with Foreign Minister Valdis Birkavs and the MFA's Strategic planning group to discuss eastern foreign policy. President Ulmanis urged MFA to work more actively in developing relations with Russia.
- The 16th meeting of the CIS Railway Council opened yesterday in Jurmala.
- On September 1 Latvia's unemployment rate reached 7.1 percent.
- Board of the Latvian Privatisation Agency has approved stock capital of the Latvian Shipping Company- $400 million.
